colors.instructions: Replace the root variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css with these values. Ensure dark mode variables are also adjusted to be legible but deep (e.g., background: 222 47% 11%).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white shadow-md hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all active:scale-95 rounded-md
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all rounded-md

cards.default: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.interactive: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 cursor-pointer hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

sidebar.container: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 w-64 flex flex-col border-r border-slate-800 shadow-xl z-50
sidebar.link: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium rounded-md hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white transition-colors

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Ensure stroke width is 1.5px or 2px for clarity.

implementation_steps.details: Add the Google Fonts link to public/index.html head section.
Extend the font family in tailwind.config.js to include 'Manrope' (sans) and 'Inter' (body). Ensure colors use CSS variables.
Replace the content of src/index.css with the new CSS variables (HSL values) provided in the 'colors' section.
Build a 'DashboardLayout' component that includes the Sidebar and Header. Wrap all protected routes with this.
Construct the main dashboard using the 'Bento' grid strategy. Use Shadcn cards for metrics.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds, stick to solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Use 'Inter' font for all Body text and UI elements.
Ensure all interactive elements have a focus state visible.
For tables, use a 'compact' density but keep row height at least 48px for touch targets.
Always check contrast ratios. The Primary Blue is bright, so use white text on top of it.
Data-testid attributes are MANDATORY for all inputs and buttons.
